items.title: File Widerspruch against the permit refusal
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen,
items.computation: No separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the posting day is the letter's date, Wed 18.11.2026. The letter itself confirms the 4-day rule (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG): the 4th day after posting is Sun 22.11.2026. The Ordnungsamt is a general authority (not a tax office), so under § 41 Abs. 2 LVwG/VwVfG the deemed-delivery day does NOT move even though it falls on a Sunday; Bekanntgabe = 22.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period (counted per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB) starts the next day and ends one month later on the day with the same number: 22.12.2026 (a Tuesday, no public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein), so the period end itself does not need to be shifted under § 31 Abs. 3 LVwG/VwVfG.
